summary: Build advanced health financing skills for UHC reform. Learn financing diagnostics, strategic purchasing, and policy roadmaps.
lede: Health financing training helps policy, budgeting and purchasing professionals assess how funds are raised, pooled and used to support universal health coverage. Participants practice diagnosing financing bottlenecks, comparing revenue-raising and provider-payment options, and aligning benefit packages with available funding. They also develop reform roadmaps and policy briefs, using expenditure patterns, monitoring data and Public Financial Management considerations to support practical decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with health financing policy, UHC reform, budgeting, purchasing, or health insurance design. It suits people who need to move between technical analysis and practical decision support in ministries, insurers, advocacy organizations, research units, or implementation teams.
modules: Benefit package design and priority setting
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and any non-confidential budget, coverage, or financing reports you use in your work. Familiarity with health financing terminology, basic public budgeting, and simple policy analysis will help you get the most from the exercises.
